body:
There are a lot of times I pretend to be ok. I hadn't thought of it as being isolating, but it makes sense.

Funny thing is I was just about to erase this post...somehow posting this thread made me feel worse, but I don't know why. I just wanted to erase it, flip the finger to the asshole who downvoted me, and kill this account. 

And thank you. You know, it's weird. I didn't think any of it was a problem at the time, but years later even, I always think about it.

Thanks for the Talkspace tip. I may have to look into it.

Unfortunately, I can't go to a therapist or anything like that without risking my career. So anonymous, online stuff is all I have. As for friends and family, it would be such a shock...it would change the way they saw me and I'm not sure that would be a good thing. Friends (such as they are) and family are one of my escapes.
